import arrow
# Try to create a datetime that falls in the DST gap
# Spring forward 2023 US/Eastern: March 12, 2am -> 3am
# So 2:30 AM on March 12 doesn't exist
arw = arrow.get(2023, 3, 12, 2, 30, tzinfo="US/Eastern")
print("Gap time:", arw)
print("imaginary:", arw.imaginary)
# Now shift back by 1 hour - should land in the gap
try:
    result = arw.shift(hours=-1)
    print("shift(-1):", result, "hour:", result.hour)
except Exception as e:
    print("Error:", e)
PYEOF')
